summary: Hexcel Corporation filed an 8-K (Item 1.02) disclosing the termination of its material definitive agreement related to its 3.950% Senior Notes due 2027. The company redeemed all outstanding $400 million aggregate principal of those notes using net proceeds from a prior offering of $400 million 4.900% Senior Notes due 2031 plus cash on hand. The redemption was completed on May 28, 2026, per the indenture. This is a routine debt refinancing, not a special situation. No target, acquirer, or strategic event is involved.
